ideas.pitch: An AI-powered logistics aggregator that coordinates volunteer drivers and neighborhood seniors across Atlanta for recurring grocery and medical trips.
ideas.title: PeachState Transit Co-op
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of clear measurable impact and social good seen in the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon, perfectly suited for addressing local Atlanta transit and accessibility challenges.

ideas.pitch: Satellite monitoring and change detection dashboard focused on industrial and commercial land use compliance in the greater Atlanta area.
ideas.title: ATL Industry Watch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs heavy technical execution combining geospatial APIs and computer vision, matching the runner-up strategy of GeoNex-ATLAS at the Xcelerate Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutrition assistant that adapts dietary guidelines and meal recommendations specifically to Southern US culinary staples and regional grocery availability.
